ceva_xm6_dsp_verified.slot_39_vs_40_difference: Slot 39 executes Core 0 Group-3 hardware SRAM bank switch FUN_40c93094(0,0); Slot 40 is in skip mask 0x14c00000100UL

UpdateBlurLine_1.note: 14-byte passthrough returning src_line and setting *ready = (src_line != nullptr)

UpdateBlurLine_5.note: True 2D rank-3 non-separable 5x5 Gaussian {40,26,15,7,3,0} >> 8 (truncating VMAC3, corners=0, BORDER_REFLECT_101)

ApplyMaptoImageLine.note: Applies staggered 2D grain_map + per-32px Marsaglia xorshift32 +-1 sign flip + Q6 tone_lut[Y] >> 6 + [0,255] vst{satu} on Plane 0 (Luma Y)

switch_jump_tables.semantic_role: Clang SwitchToLookupTable value arrays indexed by in->blur_kernel_size (in+0x51, valid mask 0x2a9 -> {0,3,5,7,9}): Pass 1 fn (0x38f40) + flush lines (0x38ee0) and Pass 2 fn (0x38f70) + flush lines (0x38f10)

mipu_geometry.note: theta_m = m * 11.25 deg = atan2(Cr, Cb) mod 360 deg maps ring index m in 0..31 to MIPU hardware sector index ring_to_mipu_slice_index[m].

base_curve_standard_229.description: Standard Picture Control 229-pt 15-bit scene-to-display base curve

highlights_basis_4x257_s16.description: Highlights 257-pt basis deltas (divisor 120): rows [std_neg, std_pos, flex_neg, flex_pos]

shadows_basis_4x257_s16.description: Shadows 257-pt basis deltas (divisor 120): rows [std_neg, std_pos, flex_neg, flex_pos]

color_grading_breakpoints_4_u16.description: Color Grading luma zone breakpoints [220, 352, 528, 672] on 0..1024

color_grading_luma_envelope_65_s16.description: Color Grading 65-pt Q10 luma chroma-protection envelope

color_grading_hue_rgb_360x3_s16.description: Color Grading 360-deg Hue (dR, dG, dB) vector basis

color_blender_hue_basis_16x32_s16.description: Color Blender 8-channel -> 32-sector Hue rotation basis (8192 = 360 deg)

color_blender_chroma_basis_16x32_s16.description: Color Blender 8-channel -> 32-sector Q10 Chroma gain delta basis (1024 = 1.0x)

color_blender_chroma_luma_cross_32x2_s16.description: Color Blender positive-Chroma -> Luma (Cb, Cr) Helmholtz-Kohlrausch damping vector

zf_c301_xm6_filmgrain_kernels.border_mode_hardware: BORDER_REFLECT_101 (NumPy mode='reflect', both horizontal and vertical)
zf_c301_xm6_filmgrain_kernels.rounding_mode_hardware: truncate_floor (round_bias = 0, no {rnd} modifier in VSWGENMAC or VMAC3)

apply_map_simd_perm.description: 32-byte CEVA-XM6 256-bit vector lane permutation mask swapping high 128-bit [16..31] and low 128-bit [0..15] halves for 128-entry grain_map vlut

zf_c301_xm6_format_switch_tables.note: Two-stage serial BlurLineRing cascade (Pass 1 @ Ring 1 0x2f780 -> Pass 2 @ Ring 2 0x2f798), synthesizing 1x1 (0), 3x3 (3), 5x5 (5), 7x7 = 5x5*3x3 (7), and 9x9 = 5x5*5x5 (9) spatial blur scales.

fields.name: map_blend_weight
fields.note: Q4 blend weight w in [0..16]: ((w*mapA + (16-w)*mapB) >> 4); full-res LUT 0xa02aec201=[2,3,7,11,16,16], small-res LUT 0xa02aec1f8=[2,2,3,4,6,9]

fields.name: blur_kernel_size
fields.note: allowed {0, 3, 5, 7, 9} via mask 0x2a9; full-res LUT 0xa02aec207=[3,5,9], small-res LUT 0xa02aec1fe=[3,3,3]

fields.name: tile_step
fields.note: S; ARM64 FUN_40e44bec hardcodes 0x17 = 23 (prime stride mod 83 -> 415x415 aperiodic tiling)

fields.name: tone_knee_lo
fields.note: shadow ramp knee; ARM64 FUN_40e44bec hardcodes 0x20 = 32

fields.name: tone_knee_hi
fields.note: highlight ramp knee; ARM64 FUN_40e44bec hardcodes 0xdf = 223

fields.name: prng_seed
fields.note: Marsaglia xorshift32 seed from FUN_40c7d584 monotonic timer (0 replaced with 0x12345678)

fields.name: mapA_addr
fields.note: 64B-aligned DMA copy of Map0 (0xa02b7237c) or Map1 (0xa02b7594e for full-res intensity 6)

fields.name: mapB_addr
fields.note: 64B-aligned DMA buffer, always zero-filled (memset 0, 0x35d2) by FUN_40e44bec

adjacent_fgsf_unit.note: Separate scs::fgsf Fast Guided Smoothing Filter unit in .text (unrelated to FilmGrain)

fixed_input_scalars.cache_clean_invalidate_op: dc CIVAC on mapA(0x35d2), mapB(0x35d2), in_struct(0x80 @ 0xa1be9ebe0), out_struct(0x38 @ 0xa1be9ec60)
